chat_messages.text: Hello Nexora Support. I’m seeing unusual activity from your privileged account in our environment. Can you confirm whether this activity is authorized?
Hi Maya. We haven’t seen any alerts on our side. We’re investigating. Please stand by.
We’ve investigated and found no evidence that our environment has been compromised.
Understood. We’re correlating this activity with multiple security alerts. I’ve been directed by our SOC Manager to temporarily disable your privileged access while we investigate further.
Disabling our access will interrupt critical support services.
